title: RSAFS (Advance Retail Sales: Retail Trade and Food Services) — real-time vintage table of 2024 estimates as of 2024-09-17
text:
RSAFS — Advance Retail Sales: Retail Trade and Food Services
Source: ALFRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis archival FRED), series RSAFS. Underlying data: U.S. Census Bureau (MARTS). Units: millions of dollars, seasonally adjusted.
Revision schedule: advance estimate mid-month; revised in each of the next two monthly releases.

VINTAGE TABLE — the value of RSAFS for each reference month exactly as published on each pre-cutoff release (vintage) date. Reading across a row shows how the estimate for that month was revised in later releases.
